source_ref: User-provided TELCO-6117 acceptance criteria and approved automation scope

configuration.CONTACT_US_BASE_URL: Required test/staging base URL; scripts navigate to /contact-us
configuration.SELENIUM_HEADLESS: Optional; set true for headless Chrome execution

traceability.scope: Select the first implemented contact option and continue the flow
Request hand-off when an agent is available
Request hand-off when it is unavailable and verify fallback presentation

known_limitations: All data-testid locators are placeholders approved by the user and require mapping to the implemented UI.
Agent availability and unavailability require environment setup not specified in the ticket.
No executable assertions are included for AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, peak load, or PII handling because measurable targets, standards, references, and policies were not supplied.
